# Robin & Radish

> A UK garden guide to growing vegetables and herbs at home and feeding garden birds. Sowing dates are general ranges for the north and south of the UK, with a separate Ireland page. Bird feeding notes describe ordinary foods and how to offer them. Some links go to seed and bird-food shops and are labelled as affiliate links. The site does not publish scores, star ratings or prices.

## Start here
- [Start here](https://robinandradish.co.uk/start-here/): a short path through the sowing planner, bird food quiz, this month, and the first guides
- [This week](https://robinandradish.co.uk/this-week/): the weekly note on what to sow, harvest, and put in the feeder
- [What to sow by month](https://robinandradish.co.uk/what-to-sow/): month-by-month sowing and planting lists for the UK
- [2027 sowing calendar](https://robinandradish.co.uk/sowing-calendar-2027/): the year at a glance, with printable A3 PDFs
- [Sowing planner](https://robinandradish.co.uk/planner/): pick crops and region to get sowing windows
- [Bird food quiz](https://robinandradish.co.uk/quiz/): which food suits which garden birds
- [Ireland sowing dates](https://robinandradish.co.uk/ie/sowing/): sowing ranges for Ireland

## Guides
- [Aphids without a spray](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/aphids-without-sprays/): What to do about aphids on UK beans, chillies and soft growth, using your fingers, water and the insects that eat them.
- [Attracting robins](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/attracting-robins/): Food, cover and a nest box that suit robins in a UK garden, and how to offer food where a robin can reach it.
- [Bird feeder buying guide](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/bird-feeder-buying-guide/): How to choose a hanging feeder, a nyjer feeder, a tray or a suet cage for a UK garden. No prices or rankings.
- [Bird food for winter](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/bird-food-for-winter/): Plain notes on sunflower hearts, nyjer, suet, mealworms and mixed seed for UK garden birds in winter, plus water and foods to avoid.
- [Blight on potatoes and tomatoes](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/blight-potatoes-tomatoes/): How to spot potato and tomato blight in a UK summer, what to do with the foliage, and how rotation helps next year.
- [Carrot fly on the vegetable row](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/carrot-fly/): How carrot fly shows up in a UK garden, and the covers, timing and thinning that limit the damage.
- [Cleaning bird feeders](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/feeder-hygiene/): How to clean bird feeders and bird baths, how often to do it, and what to do if birds at the feeder look unwell.
- [Compost for a small plot](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/compost-small-plot/): How to make compost in a small UK garden, what to leave out of the heap, and how to use it on a vegetable bed.
- [Crop rotation for a small plot](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/crop-rotation/): A practical crop rotation for a UK bed that is too small for a textbook four-year plan, using the plant families on this site.
- [Feeding birds in spring and summer](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/feeding-birds-spring-summer/): Whether to keep feeding UK garden birds after winter, what to take down in warm weather, and which foods do not belong on the table.
- [Garlic and broad beans over winter](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/garlic-and-broad-beans-over-winter/): How to plant garlic and hardy broad beans for a UK winter, by region, and when to leave the bed alone.
- [Growing vegetables in containers](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/growing-in-containers/): Which vegetables and herbs are worth growing in pots in the UK, how deep the pot needs to be, and why watering matters more than the compost brand.
- [Hardening off seedlings](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/hardening-off/): How to move UK seedlings from a windowsill or greenhouse outside without losing them to wind or a cold night.
- [Herbs for a small space](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/herbs-small-space/): A short list of herbs that earn a UK windowsill or a metre of bed, and which ones need a pot of their own.
- [Nest boxes for garden birds](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/nest-boxes/): Which UK garden birds use a hole box, which need an open front, and where to put a box so it has a chance of being used.
- [Netting fruit without trapping birds](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/netting-soft-fruit/): How to net fruit and brassicas in a UK garden so pigeons and bullfinches stay off the crop and birds are not caught in the mesh.
- [No-dig beds for vegetables](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/no-dig-beds/): How a no-dig vegetable bed works in a UK garden: compost on the surface, cardboard on a new plot, and what still has to be done by hand.
- [Planning a vegetable plot for 2027](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/planning-a-veg-plot-2027/): A winter plan for a UK vegetable plot in 2027: beds, seed to order, and what not to sow yet.
- [Raised beds for vegetables](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/raised-beds/): Size, materials and filling for a raised vegetable bed in a UK garden, including timber to avoid on a food bed.
- [Saving vegetable seed](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/saving-seed/): Which UK garden vegetables are worth saving seed from, which ones will not come true, and how to dry and store a small packet.
- [Slugs without pellets](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/slugs-without-pellets/): How to protect UK seedlings from slugs without pellets: where they hide, what to pick off, and which barriers are worth trying.
- [Sow little and often](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/successional-sowing/): How to sow short rows of UK salads and quick crops every few weeks so they do not all finish on the same day.
- [Sowing under cover](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/sowing-under-cover/): When a UK gardener should sow on a windowsill, in a cold frame or under a cloche, and how to harden plants off before they go outside.
- [Starting a vegetable patch](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/starting-a-veg-patch/): How to choose a spot, clear weeds and start a small UK vegetable patch, with a short list of forgiving first crops.
- [The hungry gap](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/hungry-gap/): What is still edible in a UK garden from April into early June, and what to sow so the gap is shorter next year.
- [Water for garden birds](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/water-for-garden-birds/): How to offer drinking and bathing water to UK garden birds in a freeze and in a dry spell, and what not to add to it.
- [What to sow in winter](https://robinandradish.co.uk/guides/what-to-sow-in-winter/): What you can still sow or plant in a UK garden in winter, what to grow on a windowsill, and what to leave until spring.
